name: Green (Paragon Hag Family)
body:
Of all the hags, green hags are the closest to nature and the natural world. Their paragon hag families can easily be mistaken for aging druids or retired rangers.

Family Spells: pass without trace (3rd), invisibility (6th), tongues (9th), command plants (12th), beast shape III (15th), repel wood (18th)
Ritual Spells–Knowledge (Nature): spike stones (5th), commune with nature (7th), ironwood (9th), control weather (11th), earthquake (13th), elemental swarm (earth only) (15th), extended shapechange (17th), extended sympathetic* polymorph any object (19th)
Family Abilities: Green paragon hags are increasingly connected with the natural world.
Covered in Hides (Ex)

You are proficient with all non-metal armor and shields and cast spells with no chance of arcane spell failure while using them.

Mimicry (Ex)

At 4th level, you learn the surprising powers of mimicry. You gain a +4 bonus to Bluff and Disguise checks to pass yourself off as someone else. This bonus increases to +8 at 12th level and +12 at 20th level.

Aquatic Hag (Ex)

At 8th level, you may breathe underwater and gain a swim speed of 30’. At 16th level, these benefits extend to members of your coven.

Sapping Claws (Su)

At 12th level, every time you hit a living creature with your claws, they must attempt a Fortitude save or take 2 Strength damage. The Save DC is equal to 10 + 1/2 your paragon hag level + your Charisma modifier.

Green Lore (Su)

At 16th level, you can spend a soul point as a standard action to add a spell from the druid or ranger spell list to your spells known. This spell remains on your list until the next time you regain spells.

Legendary Family

Upon reaching 20th level, all the animals of the land and sea flock to you. You may cast mass charm monster at will, targeting animals, magical beasts, and vermin (even if they are mindless) with Intelligence less than 3. If a creature succeeds at its save it is not immediately hostile, but is immune to this ability until you next regain spells.
